title: Unit Event — Halt! Tenma's on the Case — Episode7 To Greater Heights

meta.Event Outline: At Kijima's suggestion, Tsukasa has been putting on muscle to increase his acting chops. He and the others arrive at the Jidaigeki Studio Park with the Mikazukigumi troupe, but news of a theft puts the new production on hold...and that's when Tsukasa spots a suspicious ninja on the lot!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What are the odds of us running into the thief right after meeting back up...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, how is this guy so fast...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, we're going to lose him at this rate...!
The other troupe members said they called in for reinforcements, but I don't know if they'll make it in time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No!!!
The ninja thief's too fast!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh...?
There's someone standing on the other side of the road.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
You've got nowhere to run now!
Give up already!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If we can keep driving him in Mr. Kijima's direction, then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-He jumped towards that wall... And now he's climbing up it?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa!!! He's like a real ninja!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
W-We don't have time to gawk!
He's gonna get away.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Wait...
Is he going to climb up that wall to catch him?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?!
But I thought he couldn't figure out how to wall jump...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I have to kick the right part of the wall.
I can't go too high or too low.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It has to be a part of the wall where I can get a good enough footing to push off hard.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I succeeded up to that point during practice, but always found myself coming up one step short.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(But...
After hearing that piece of advice, I know what to do now!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I struggled to climb because I wasn't thinking about propelling myself up.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I was too focused on getting a good grip on the wall, and ended up leaning into it too much.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which means I just need to use my entire body to jump upwards! That's all I have to do!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I can do this now! I know it...!
That piece of advice should allow me to...!!!)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Go as high as you can!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
B-But this seems really dangerous...!
If they get into a grappling contest up there...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're coming with me! The underworld awaits us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-He tackled him. But they're so high up...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (At this rate, we're both going to slam into the ground! However...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'll be fine! Because I have friends!!!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Mr. Kijima's running over with something really fluffy-looking!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Are those bales of hay...?!
Oh, he's using the things that were in front of the tatami shop as cushions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Phew...
I think we made it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
H-He did it!!!
They're both safe!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
You're not getting away this time!
And you'll be giving your statement at the park office.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, Mr. Kijima...!
I wouldn't have been able to catch him without your help!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
No, Tenma, you deserve all the credit.
I think he would've gotten away again if we'd just ambushed him.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: In any case, it's finally over...

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Did you see that, Mommy?!
That was so cool!!!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Yes, it was...!
It was like a real police chase!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: I'd heard that the shows they do here are good, but not this good...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, they all seem to believe that it was some kind of performance.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “We really had our hands full with this one, didn't we, Mr. Ginnosuke...?!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“His speed and agility...
I'm still yet to actually come face to face with him, but he reminded me of that swift-footed thief, Chusuke.”

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
“Easy, Heihachi.
This one's nothing compared to Chusuke.”

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
“He's got the fastest legs under the sun!
Otherwise, he wouldn't be called the swift-footed thief.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Right...!
I've got a feeling we can catch anyone as long as we work together, Mr. Ginnosuke!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That concludes this special episode of “Ginnosuke's on the Case!”, which has been temporarily canceled.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We hope you'll all come watch when we're allowed to resume!!!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Cool...!
I didn't know there was more to this story!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: What we saw today was good, but now I wanna see who this other baddie is. I mean, he sounded really tough!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: (He's still young, but has honed his acting skills and raised his fitness to an incredible level. Not only that, he's able to make the picture in his head a reality when things really count...)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: (The heart required to be able to do that...)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: (It allows him to make all the guests smile like this. He genuinely wants them to enjoy themselves.)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I can't wait to see what happens moving forward...!
